body:
Claim: PM loop round R1 (slot refill) — `domain:spec` seat (seat post #6017). Executing the maintainer ruling carried by the director seat (this card's body; origin objectui#7189, batch #7, verbatim 「7189 A  其他同意」, 2026-09-02): **A — grouping on a list view is server-side**; this card is the spec half (the first of three). The design call the card hands to this seat — "whether this is a new query shape on the data endpoint or a reuse of the dataset aggregate query" — is **ruled: reuse, no new query shape** (third tier, premises below; the dev verifies them before writing and stops on a falsified one).
Session: `session_01H2oQebDDxYKfWZusyd8GXk` (GitHub `os-justin`)
Branch: `claude/issue-14556-list-view-grouping-contract`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-14556`
Domain: `domain:spec`
**Seat ruling (third tier).** (1) The group set and every number in a group header are ONE ObjectQL aggregate query, expressed in the vocabulary the query AST already declares: `groupBy` = the list view's `grouping.fields[].field` in nesting order (multi-level grouping = a multi-column `groupBy`, headers derived from the grouped keys at each level), `aggregations` = a `count` node plus the view's declared per-column summaries mapped onto `AggregationFunction` (`data/query.zod.ts`: count / sum / avg / min / max / count_distinct — one vocabulary, the one datasets use), `where` = the view's composed filter (the same filter the row query carries). (2) Rows inside a group are the EXISTING paged `find` with the group's key predicate AND-ed into the view filter (`top` / `skip` per group). (3) The execution contract is the existing `IDataEngine.aggregate(objectName, EngineAggregateOptions, options)` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts`) — ⛔ no new engine verb, no new envelope. (4) The spec half delivers the contract text on the list-view grouping (JSDoc + describe on `GroupingConfigSchema` / `GroupingFieldSchema`: server-side; groups and counts are query properties; rows within a group are paged) AND a **checkable artifact** — a pure helper in `packages/spec` that compiles a list view's `grouping` + filter + column summaries into the `EngineAggregateOptions` header query and the per-group row query, with pins on the card's 186-row / five-unit / `$top: 100` fixture (counts 86/61/31/7/1 regardless of row order) — ⛔ prose alone is not a deliverable. **Premises the dev verifies first**: (a) `AggregationNodeSchema` + `groupBy` on the query AST and `EngineAggregateOptions` cover multi-column `groupBy` with `count`; (b) the engine's `aggregate()` executes them on the SQL and memory drivers (read, not run: the dev cites the dispatch sites). **Two forks are STOP-AND-REPORT, never decided by the dev**: (i) `ColumnSummarySchema` members with no `AggregationFunction` counterpart (`count_empty` / `count_filled` / `count_unique` / `percent_*` …) — report the exact mapping table and which members are unmappable; ⛔ do not invent a third vocabulary and do not silently drop them; (ii) the REST door — no `aggregate` route exists on the data endpoint today (`packages/rest/src` mounts none; the only aggregate path is the analytics dataset route); if the spec half needs to declare a new public route or wire shape, that is ADR-class ⇒ report the shape you would propose and stop (the platform half, item 2 of the card, carries the route; this seat files it at ACCEPT). ⛔ No ADR is written under reuse; ⛔ no engine / REST / objectui code.
File surface: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (the grouping block `GroupingFieldSchema` / `GroupingConfigSchema` + the `ColumnSummarySchema` docs — JSDoc/describe only unless a member is added, which is a fork to report), a new helper module beside it (placement the dev's call inside `packages/spec/src/ui/` or `kernel/`; exported from the `ui` entry) + its test, generated followers the gates prove stale (`references/ui/view.mdx`, `authorable-surface/ui.json`, api-surface / export-origins / declaration-map for the new export), one `@objectstack/spec` changeset. `contracts/data-engine.ts` read-only. ⛔ Not `packages/objectql`, not `packages/rest`, not objectui. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: M–L, `mode:subagent`, `model: fable` — `--tier` on `ui/view.zod.ts` at `9c1bcda3` (06:44Z): no path-derived mandate, Clause ② SUSPECT hint; judged from content: a new exported helper (mechanical floor) and a published contract's declared semantics (`grouping` becomes server-side by declaration) ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
Clause-②: yes
Serial constraints cleared: `ui/view.zod.ts` last touched `e9b377e8` (#14111, 2026-09-03; free on the seat post); 0 open PRs on it at 07:03Z (branch-name read of the open PR list); in-flight lane cards (#14462 family, #14559) do not touch it. **H17 hit**: `ui/view.zod.ts` is a declared `Restart-touch` trigger file of #8346 (`pm:on-hold`, PDF/print export, v18) — notification posted on that card per its precedent; no rider work is taken (zero export/print surface here), the hold stands. objectui#7189 is `pm:blocked` on this card (its landing note is the acceptance fixture's source).

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Dispatch (R1 slot refill, 2026-09-04T07:05Z) — `domain:spec` seat, `session_01H2oQebDDxYKfWZusyd8GXk` (`os-justin`), seat post #6017. `mode:subagent`, `model: fable` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`), size M–L, Clause ② yes (dual carrier: the dev hangs `needs:contract-review` on the PR and on this card in one stroke when the draft PR exists — no pre-hang). The dev leaves its own `Claim:` comment below before its first edit.

**Rulings (not re-decidable).** Maintainer: A (objectui#7189, batch #7, 「7189 A  其他同意」) — the card body's "Ruled: A" paragraph and "Scope, three halves in order" item 1 verbatim: "Define what `grouping` on a list view means and what the platform returns for it: the group keys, the per-group total count, the per-group aggregations (the same aggregation vocabulary datasets already use, one vocabulary and not two, per objectui#4576), and the paging model for rows within a group." Seat ruling (claim 5536962024): **reuse, no new query shape** — items (1)–(4) there are the contract; the two forks (i) unmappable `ColumnSummarySchema` members, (ii) a REST door that would need a new public route/wire shape, are STOP-AND-REPORT. ⛔ No ADR under reuse; ⛔ not `packages/objectql`, `packages/rest`, objectui.

**PM mechanism assumptions (verify; falsify freely — report, then follow the ruling's intent).** (a) `AggregationNodeSchema` + `groupBy` on the query AST (`data/query.zod.ts`, incl. the `{ field, dateGranularity }` groupBy member form) and `EngineAggregateOptions` cover multi-column `groupBy` + `count` with an alias; (b) the engine's `aggregate()` dispatch (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, the `drv.aggregate` presence test) executes it on driver-sql and on the in-memory fallback — cite the sites, do not run the engine; (c) `ColumnSummarySchema` (`view.zod.ts`) is the view's own per-column summary vocabulary and `ListColumn.summary` its authoring site — the header aggregation for a group reuses THAT declaration (the same list of summaries the footer computes), mapped onto `AggregationFunction`; build the mapping table (`count` → count, `count_unique` → count_distinct, `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` → same, …) and list every member with no counterpart as fork (i); (d) a per-group row page is the existing `find` with `where: { $and: [viewFilter, { [groupField]: groupKey }] }` — verify the filter AST spells AND-composition that way and that a null group key has a spellable predicate; (e) generated followers: `references/ui/view.mdx` (describes), `authorable-surface/ui.json` (only if a member is added — that would be a fork), `api-surface` / `export-origins` / `declaration-map` for the new export; (f) changeset `@objectstack/spec` `minor` (a new exported helper + declared contract semantics; not breaking — the previously undeclared page-scoped behaviour was never the contract).

**PM suggested route (optional; measured beats suggested).** Helper module `packages/spec/src/ui/view-grouping-query.ts` (or the name the `ui` entry's conventions give): `compileListViewGroupQuery(view, filter) → EngineAggregateOptions` (groupBy in nesting order, `count` + mapped summaries, `where`) and `compileGroupRowsQuery(view, filter, groupKeys, page) → QueryAST` (the AND-ed predicate + `top`/`skip`); pins: the 186-row five-unit fixture as an in-memory reduction over the compiled header query yields 86/61/31/7/1 for both row orders the card measured (contiguous and interleaved); a two-level grouping compiles to a two-column `groupBy`; a summary with no counterpart refuses loudly at compile time with `code` + `path` (not a silent drop) — if fork (i) is reported, that refusal IS the interim contract and says so. JSDoc on `GroupingConfigSchema`: server-side; groups and counts are query properties; rows within a group are paged; the platform half (#14556 item 2) and objectui (#7189) are named as the follow-ons.

**Surface, gates, report.** File surface = the claim comment 5536962024 (stop on breach). Consumer-package readings for a contract card: `@objectstack/spec` (`src/ui` tests + the new pins), `@objectstack/objectql` typecheck (nothing should change — the helper is additive), objectui at `24e027e9` read-only: `plugin-grid`'s `useGroupedData` and `ObjectGrid` grouped branch are the future consumers — report what they would call, no edit. Derive gates from your actual paths after the last commit (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`, no path args); the spec `check:*` families, `check:generated --fix` then a clean run, `check:api-surface` / `export-origins` / `declaration-map` regenerated for the new export, `check-system-context-census` (`--fix` if demanded), `check:spec-parsed-alias`, `check-affected-docs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, eslint on edited TS. Report: `os-dev-report` first as a comment here, then as the return; machine-checkable fields only (status, pr, premise_still_valid per premise, files_changed, gates pinned to the head sha, the mapping table for fork (i), the REST-door answer for fork (ii), deviations, open_questions, out_of_scope_findings filed as cards after a dedup search). Follow-ups the seat files at ACCEPT, not the dev: the platform half card (REST/ObjectQL, `Blocked-by: #14556`) and the objectui#7189 unblock note.
